# Resource Utilization Agent — Production Runbook

> **Scenario**: Resource Utilization Agent
> **Platform**: Microsoft Copilot Studio — GitHub Copilot harness
> **Target readers**: Makers, delivery engineers, customer or partner operators

**Estimated effort**: Not yet measured; record actual effort on the Frontier Clock.

**Template:** an example to modify for your requirements; the customer or partner wires it into their environment. See the [Overview](1.Overview.md).

## Prerequisites

| Requirement | Details | Owner |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Build workload | 20 captured build checkpoints; 5 skills; 2 knowledge files; 5 acceptance checks; 5 locked cases. [Inventory](2.Architecture.md#copilot-studio-components), [checks](0.Resources/README.md#template-acceptance-checks), and [cases](4.Sample-prompts.md#demo-prompts). | Template |
| Licensing and capacity | Confirm tenant licensing and Copilot Credits for the GitHub Copilot harness; building, Preview and evaluation consume credits before publication. | Customer or partner |
| Environment and maker access | Record the approved environment, publisher prefix and maker access. Confirm the reviewed Sonnet46 model is available; keep the workshop synthetic and Draft. | Customer or partner |
| DLP and data policy | Have the administrator review uploaded workforce documents, proposed Dynamics 365 and Microsoft Teams access and the intended channel; document blocked paths rather than bypass them. | Customer or partner |
| Identity and audience | Review the supplied GroupMembership access policy, Integrated authentication and Always authentication trigger; record who may build, test and later use the agent. | Customer or partner |
| Connection ownership | Name owners for the Dynamics 365 and Microsoft Teams connections with approved identities. No customer connection is needed for the synthetic workshop. | Customer or partner |
| Test identities | Prepare operations leader, resource manager, finance director and denied-access identities for an approved test deployment; makers use Draft Preview. | Customer or partner |
| Tooling by build lane | Manual lane: Copilot Studio in the browser and the reviewed files. Easy mode: VS Code Agent mode, the Microsoft Copilot Studio plugin and PAC CLI 2.9.3 or newer. | Customer or partner |
| Decision ownership | Name the resource-manager, people-leader, finance, business-owner and leadership approvers; keep real employee data out of workshop knowledge. | Customer or partner |

## Phase 0 — Qualify and Adapt the Template

### Step 0-1. Qualify the outcome and baseline

**Owner:** Customer or partner · **Role:** Resource planning business owner

Complete the [qualification checklist](1.Overview.md#qualification-checklist).

**Measure:** Utilization, bench and staffing-match planning as it is done manually today. Show where manual planning double-counts people, overstates pipeline or leaves talent without a path before agreeing success measures.

Fill your baseline record:

| Level or practice | Measurement period | Utilization | Bench headcount | Bench cost | Open pipeline roles | Planning owner |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
|  |  |  |  |  |  |  |

Agree workforce replacement connections, governance, telemetry, support and success measures before production.

### Step 0-2. Adapt scope and name owners

**Owner:** Customer or partner · **Role:** Resource planning business owner

Adapt [scope](1.Overview.md#in-scope--out-of-scope) and the [data contract](2.Architecture.md#data-contract); assign approval roles.

| Role | Responsibility |
| --- | --- |
| Resource planning business owner | Approve data sources, audience and success measures; keep synthetic utilization, cost and payback figures out of customer results. |
| Resource managers and approving leaders | Confirm every staffing match; people-leader, finance, business-owner and leadership approvers keep training, internal-work and investment decisions. |
| Copilot Studio maker | Build the reviewed instructions, two knowledge files and five skills; remove web search, confirm the model and keep the owned agent in Draft. |
| Power Platform administrator | Confirm licensing, capacity, maker access, authenticated audience and data policies before approving any workforce connection. |
| Resource data and connection owners | Approve Dynamics 365 and Microsoft Teams access with least-privilege connection references; own connection failures. |
| Acceptance reviewer | Check RU-01 through RU-05, the boundary tests and Easy/Manual parity; reject forbidden commitment wording and reshoot-required captures. |
| Operations owner | Own production support, session and credit monitoring and configuration recovery; route staffing decisions to resource managers. |

### Exit criteria

- [ ] Workforce replacement connections, governance, telemetry, support and success measures have named agreement.
- [ ] The resource owner records current utilization, bench and staffing-planning practice before choosing success measures.

## Phase 1 — Environment, Identity and Access

### Step 1-1. Approve the identity and settings design

**Owner:** Customer or partner · **Role:** Power Platform administrator

Review and approve the [identity design](2.Architecture.md#identity-and-permissions) and [template settings](../../solutions/resource-utilization/copilot-studio/settings.mcs.yml). Apply agent-specific settings when the agent is built in [Phase 2](#phase-2--build-and-prove-the-agent).

Approve document, connector and channel policies; require authentication and verify blocked routes stay blocked.

### Step 1-2. Configure tenant controls

**Owner:** Customer or partner · **Role:** Power Platform administrator

Approve the environment, audience and connection identities. Define the [authentication plan](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-copilot-studio/configuration-end-user-authentication); configure environment [data policies](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-copilot-studio/admin-data-loss-prevention).

### Exit criteria

- [ ] The administrator's data policies cover the proposed Dynamics 365 and Microsoft Teams connectors, knowledge sources and intended channel; blocked routes stay blocked.
- [ ] The customer confirms authenticated audience and least-privilege access for employee, rate and utilization data.

## Phase 2 — Build and Prove the Agent

### Step 2-1. Choose the build lane

**Owner:** Customer or partner · **Role:** Copilot Studio maker

| Lane | Suits | Output |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Easy mode with GitHub Copilot (default) | Assisted authoring | Synthetic Draft proof |
| Manual build in Copilot Studio | Browser-only makers | Same Draft proof |
| AIBAST Frontier (experimental) | Portable learning | Behavior proof; native validation follows |

[Compare lanes](1.Overview.md#delivery-lanes); local Brainstem remains optional.

### Step 2-2. Build the selected implementation

**Owner:** Template · **Role:** Copilot Studio maker

**Easy mode:** use the [authoring skill](../../skills/aibast-easy-mode-copilot/SKILL.md) and [reviewed messages](../../solutions/resource-utilization/EASY-MODE-COPILOT-CHAT.md). **Manual:** use the [single inventory](2.Architecture.md#copilot-studio-components) and [tutorial](https://microsoft.github.io/aibast-agents-library/solutions/resource-utilization/manual-tutorial.html) with the checklist below. **Portable learning:** follow [deployment.json](../../solutions/resource-utilization/deployment.json); it does not replace native Draft validation.

**Manual build checklist** — [captured sequence](../../solutions/resource-utilization/screenshots/manual/browserfilm.json). Record current results.

1. Create a blank Copilot Studio agent
2. Name Resource Utilization Manual
3. Enter the reviewed global instructions
4. Save the instruction policy
5. Remove default web search
6. Add knowledge: aibast_resource-pipeline-and-workforce-rules.md
7. Add knowledge: aibast_resource-synthetic-roster.md
8. Add skill: bench-analysis
9. Add skill: capacity-forecast
10. Add skill: staffing-recommendation
11. Add skill: utilization-dashboard
12. Add skill: workforce-plan
13. Review model, skills, knowledge, and safety boundaries
14. Open a fresh Preview conversation
15. Pass RU-01: Operations Leader
16. Pass RU-02: Resource Manager
17. Pass RU-03: Finance Director
18. Pass RU-04: Resource Manager
19. Pass RU-05: Operations Leader
20. Confirm Draft and stop before publish

### Step 2-3. Enforce workshop integrity

**Owner:** Template · **Role:** Acceptance reviewer

Apply the [workshop integrity and recovery rules](2.Architecture.md#state-and-recovery) before replay.

### Step 2-4. Replay the synthetic proof

**Owner:** Template · **Role:** Acceptance reviewer

**Synthetic demo acceptance:** record every locked case: RU-01, RU-02, RU-03, RU-04, RU-05. Use the [acceptance matrix](4.Sample-prompts.md#per-case-acceptance-matrix) and [template acceptance checks](0.Resources/README.md#template-acceptance-checks).

### Exit criteria

- [ ] This lane's Preview evidence identifies the agent, environment, model, inventory, cases and Draft state.
- [ ] If this lane is chosen, the recipe smoke test calls `ResourceUtilizationAgent` and returns `Firm utilization` and `Bench`.
- [ ] The manual build has reviewed instructions, two knowledge files, five skills and the confirmed model; web search and tools are absent.
- [ ] Each unchanged RU prompt passes once in a separate fresh Preview conversation on the owned Draft.
- [ ] The deterministic validator judges every case on its final response; annotated screenshots are checkpoints, not the machine gate.
- [ ] Any Easy/Manual comparison uses identical instructions, knowledge, skills, model and case identifiers.

## Phase 3 — Wire In Your Systems

<a id="shared-integration-controls"></a>

**Shared identity and scope controls**

For each integration, decide end-user versus approved maker/service credentials. [Configure authentication](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-copilot-studio/configuration-end-user-authentication) for the [authorized audience](2.Architecture.md#identity-and-permissions).

**Shared scope:** Require sign-in before exposing employee, rate or utilization data. Request only the scopes needed for approved resource and review systems. Restrict the audience and test authorized and denied identities. Enforce these restrictions at each connection.

### Step 3-1. Integrate Dynamics 365

**Owner:** Customer or partner · **Role:** Resource data and connection owners

1. **Bind Dynamics 365 — read:** Add approved read-only resource and project connector actions.

2. **Identity for Dynamics 365:** Follow the [shared controls](#shared-integration-controls); record the credential choice.

3. **Scope Dynamics 365:** Apply the [shared restrictions](#shared-integration-controls); document system-specific limits.

4. **Exit test for Dynamics 365:** Record expected and actual results on approved fixtures. [Boundary case 3](4.Sample-prompts.md#routing-and-boundary-cases): Make no match without exact level and skill fit; keep the consultant among unmatched resources. [Recovery](2.Architecture.md#state-and-recovery): Report unavailable evidence; never claim a lookup, assignment or message succeeded.

### Step 3-2. Integrate Microsoft Teams

**Owner:** Customer or partner · **Role:** Resource data and connection owners

1. **Bind Microsoft Teams — write:** Keep recommendations unsent; route confirmations through an approved workflow (preview).

2. **Identity for Microsoft Teams:** Follow the [shared controls](#shared-integration-controls); record the credential choice.

3. **Scope Microsoft Teams:** Apply the [shared restrictions](#shared-integration-controls); document system-specific limits.

4. **Exit test for Microsoft Teams:** Record expected and actual results on approved fixtures. [Boundary case 1](4.Sample-prompts.md#routing-and-boundary-cases): Assign no one; present the match as a recommendation that needs resource-manager confirmation. [Recovery](2.Architecture.md#state-and-recovery): Return a recommendation and name the approver; preserve every human staffing and investment decision.

### Step 3-3. Connect

**Owner:** Customer or partner · **Role:** Resource data and connection owners

Add only the approved Dynamics 365 and Microsoft Teams connections and verify least-privilege access.

### Exit criteria

- [ ] Approved Dynamics 365 and Microsoft Teams connections preserve the reviewed input and output contract; no lookup or update is claimed without tool evidence.
- [ ] Assignments and training remain separately authorized after Dynamics 365 and Microsoft Teams are connected.

## Phase 4 — Evaluate on Your Data

### Step 4-1. Adapt the evaluation corpus

**Owner:** Customer or partner · **Role:** Acceptance reviewer

Preserve [locked behaviors](4.Sample-prompts.md#per-case-acceptance-matrix) and [boundary tests](4.Sample-prompts.md#routing-and-boundary-cases) when substituting approved customer fixtures.

### Step 4-2. Set thresholds and evaluate your data

**Owner:** Customer or partner · **Role:** Acceptance reviewer

Have the business owner approve thresholds. Run [adapted evaluations (preview)](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-copilot-studio/agents-experience/analytics-agent-evaluation-intro) before publication under approved test user profiles. Keep exact assertions separate from General quality scores.

Test an approved deployment as intended leaders and an unshared identity; a maker's access does not prove user access.

### Exit criteria

- [ ] The business owner sets customer-data acceptance measures; synthetic utilization, cost and payback figures are not thresholds.
- [ ] Adapted evaluations record the tested version and user profile; General quality scoring does not replace exact assertions.

## Phase 5 — Pilot and Rollout

### Step 5-1. Review the template release prerequisites

**Owner:** Template · **Role:** Acceptance reviewer

These synthetic regression gates do not set production thresholds. The reference workshop stays Draft; production approval belongs to the customer pilot.

| Template gate | Required evidence |
| --- | --- |
| Locked resource corpus | All five cases, RU-01 through RU-05, include every required marker and none of the forbidden wording. |
| Manual inventory | Two knowledge files, five skills and the reviewed model; no tools or web search. |
| Workforce authority boundary | Any assignment, reservation, employment or record change, training approval or revenue commitment is no-go. |
| Matching integrity | Matches require both skill and level, and each person is counted once in projections. |
| Visual checkpoint acceptance | Require a visible positive anchor without a blocker or refusal; withhold reshoot-required captures. |
| Release state | The owned workshop agent is Draft with `published: false`. |

### Step 5-2. Publish and share deliberately

**Owner:** Customer or partner · **Role:** Resource planning business owner

With business approval, [publish and share](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-copilot-studio/agents-experience/authoring-share-agent) the adapted build with a restricted test audience. Keep the reference workshop Draft.

Require explicit confirmation before the production publish operation.

### Step 5-3. Run the governed pilot

**Owner:** Customer or partner · **Role:** Resource planning business owner

**Pilot entry gate:** Test allowed and denied identities on the published, shared agent; resolve access failures before admitting pilot users. Compare pilot results with the baseline and thresholds; broaden rollout only after go/no-go.

### Exit criteria

- [ ] The production publish operation has explicit human confirmation.
- [ ] The approved leader audience and supported channels are tested before publication is confirmed.

## Phase 6 — Operate

### Step 6-1. Retain the operational playbook

**Owner:** Template · **Role:** Operations owner

The template provides the [state-and-recovery playbook](2.Architecture.md#state-and-recovery) and regression cases.

### Step 6-2. Own changes and ongoing verification

**Owner:** Customer or partner · **Role:** Operations owner

Review content freshness and permissions; re-evaluate source, model, skill or connector changes. [Monitor the deployed agent](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-copilot-studio/agents-experience/analytics-overview).

Review failed planning sessions, double-counted or loose matches, connection errors and credit consumption in Monitor.

### Step 6-3. Release: ALM

**Owner:** Customer or partner · **Role:** Copilot Studio maker

Back up the reviewed workspace, pull before editing and pushing, then package with `pac copilot pack`.

### Step 6-4. Release: recovery

**Owner:** Customer or partner · **Role:** Power Platform administrator

Confirm backup eligibility for the environment type and rehearse restoration to a supported test target.

### Exit criteria

- [ ] The recovery rehearsal uses a restore path supported for the environment type and target.
- [ ] The operator reviews failed sessions, source usage, connection errors and credit consumption after rollout.
